title: CvParsed (v1) data
description: The CV parser extracted structured information from an application's CV.

job_id.description: Carried forward so the matching service needs nothing from other services.

skills.description: Normalised, lower-case skill names, e.g. "terraform", "aws lambda".

years_of_experience.description: Best estimate, or null when the CV doesn't say.

languages.description: Spoken languages found in the CV, e.g. "english", "german".
